purpose: Replay verification of the twelve secondary factors (screen ICIR >= 0.5, previously unclassified) against historical YesLab values over 2025-01, establishing which factor_id->calculator mappings are machine-precision correct.
market_scope: full market SH/SZ (+BJ codes present in source)
verified_machine_precision: yeslab_140 日换手率波动1个月 (6.3e-12)
yeslab_214 量价齐飞乘换手率5日均值 (2.3e-10)
verified_note: Overlap comparisons at machine precision; BLOCKED labels reflect minor Tushare market coverage gaps (a few codes), not formula mismatch. These five mappings are trusted for canonical evaluation.
wrong_mapping: yeslab_212 量价齐飞-排名 (99.99% mismatch, max_abs 1.49)
industry_class: yeslab_359 行业标准化绝对值乘行业波动率 (100% mismatch; industry classification PIT vs historical static)
next_step: Canonical train+validation evaluation of the five verified factors.

canonical_evaluation_results.conclusion: All five machine-precision-verified secondary factors fail canonical training gates; historical screen ICIR (0.54-0.63) overstated them. Secondary-12 workstream closes with zero new candidates.

partial_mismatch_resolution.finding: Row-level diagnosis of yeslab_272 (smallest partial mismatch, 8-14% at gate tolerance) shows: 99.5% of overlap rows match to ~1e-7; only 458 rows (0.5%, 28 stocks) differ materially; 15 of 28 are BJ codes (out of scope), the 13 SH/SZ codes are recent IPOs (301xxx/302xxx/688xxx families) with hfq anchor divergence.
partial_mismatch_resolution.conclusion: Mappings for 252/260/271/272 (same hfq-volatility family) are verified correct; the partial mismatch is noise-plus-IPO-anchor, not a formula problem. Canonical evaluation is trustworthy.

wrong_mapping_resolution.yeslab_212: Formula-variant issue: FlyCalculator-family factors 209/211/214 (same raw close/turnover inputs) replay at machine precision, so the historical close/turnover series match; the historical 量价齐飞-排名 value must therefore have been generated by a different rank-variant formula than FlyRankCalculator. Variant search deferred (low priority).
wrong_mapping_resolution.yeslab_83: Alpha74Calculator is the only Alpha74 implementation; 100% mismatch indicates the historical value used a different variant or unit convention. Variant search deferred (low priority).
wrong_mapping_resolution.priority: LOW - screen priors 0.638/0.523 do not justify unbounded variant search while higher-value candidates are pending admission

resolution_summary: Of the twelve secondary factors: five machine-precision-verified factors rejected on canonical gates; four partial-mismatch factors verified as noise-plus-IPO-anchor then rejected on canonical gates; two wrong-mapping factors deferred (low priority variant search); one industry-class factor (359) remains replay-blocked.
